第十一章没添油加醋只加辣

顾城已经站在派出所门口，只是这次头终于低下了。

“带户口本了吗？”

“带了，这是我写的欠条，你看看。”

闫嫣接过欠条，欠五百，每月还20，要还25个月，超过两年了。

“上面加一条，每月一号准时寄钱，晚一天补偿一块钱，以此类推。

并写上共同监督人，万一你某天玩个失踪，我去找谁要？”

“闫嫣，你怎么会变化这么大？”

“再没变化连自己的命都要没了，毕竟能看着亲生孩子死，我这个花二十块钱娶进门的人又算什么。”

顾城深深看闫嫣一眼，有些失望，但还是在纸上加上她的所有条件。

“陈伯山？你确定他会为你作保？”

“会的。”

“我不信，他的单位，电话，只有名字没一点用。”

闫嫣是真厌恶顾城一棍子打不出个屁的性子，让她容易暴躁。

顾城手里的笔应声捏断，可见真被气破功了。

“我不能给他的单位和电话。”

“欠条不成立，爸妈，咱们去武某部一趟，倒要问问是谁帮顾城出头，做伤天害理的事。”

“好，咱们先去供销社买几个搪瓷盆，敲着响。”

闫家人干啥都速度，话落人都爬上牛车了，后面还跟着闫和平的兄弟们。

顾城没反应过来，郑启也没反应过来，等醒神一个急着追，另一个捂着脸笑，生怕别人看到他掩饰不住的幸灾乐祸。

“闫嫣！你停下，我必须经过陈伯山的同意才能给地址和电话。”

“原来你签下名字时人家根本不知情，我是该夸你蠢呢，还是该夸你没道德。”

闫嫣懒散的靠在老妈身上，和跑步配合老牛速度的顾城一句句搭的挺不错。

她已经确定了陈伯山的单位，既然刚才敢威胁自己，那么就要付出些代价，有本事把他们全家都给抓起来。

Chapter 11: No oil or vinegar, just spicy

Gu Cheng was already standing at the door of the police station, but this time he finally lowered his head.

"Did you bring your household registration book?"

"Take it. This is the IOU I wrote. Take a look."

Yan Yan took over the IOU and owed her 500 yuan. She had to repay 20 yuan every month for 25 months, which was more than two years ago.

“Add a line above that the money will be sent on time on the first of every month, and a dollar will be compensated for one day late, and so on.

And write down the co-supervisor. If you disappear one day, who should I go to ask for?"

"Yan Yan, why have you changed so much?"

"If I don't change, I will even lose my life. After all, if I can watch my own child die, what does it matter to me, a person who spent twenty yuan to marry me?"

Gu Cheng took a deep look at Yan Yan, a little disappointed, but still added all her conditions on the paper.

"Chen Boshan? Are you sure he will guarantee you?"

"Yes."

"I don't believe it. His work unit, phone number, and just his name are useless."

Yan Yan really hates Gu Cheng's temper that can't be beaten with a stick, which makes her easily irritable.

The pen in Gu Cheng's hand was broken with a snap, which showed that he was really defeated by Qi.

"I can't give him his unit or phone number."

"The IOU is not established. Mom and Dad, let's go to the military department and ask who helped Gu Cheng do something that is harmful to nature."

"Okay, let's go to the supply and marketing cooperative first to buy some enamel basins and knock them."

The Yan family was very fast in everything they did, and everyone climbed onto the bullock cart, followed by Yan Heping's brothers.

Gu Cheng didn't react, and Zheng Qi didn't react either. When Xingshen was waiting for him, one of them hurriedly chased after him while the other covered his face and laughed, for fear that others would see his unconcealable gloating.

"Yan Yan! Stop, I have to get Chen Boshan's permission before I can give you my address and phone number."

"It turns out that they didn't know anything about it when you signed your name. Should I praise you for being stupid, or should I praise you for being immoral."

Yan Yan leaned against her mother lazily, and she matched well with Gu Cheng, who ran at Lao Niu's speed.

She has identified Chen Boshan's unit. Since she dared to threaten her just now, she must pay a price and arrest their whole family if she can.
